instruction: My last 4 amazon orders were for my friend, Valerie. They have sent me the money for their total cost on venmo today. Check if it tallies up. If not, send or request the difference on venmo with a note "Adjusting amazon payment.".
notes: Valerie's venmo email is found through phone.search_contacts (friend contact). The four most recent amazon orders are listed with show_orders and each total is read with show_order; a small counter (c0..c4) forces all four lookups before the adjustment is made. venmo.show_transactions (filtered by user_email) gives today's money received from Valerie; the agent computes the difference at runtime. Two alternative settling actions are modeled: create_payment_request if Valerie underpaid, create_transaction if she overpaid; both carry the note 'Adjusting amazon payment.'. Since the direction is only known at runtime, the problem assumes (underpaid valerie) so the reference plan requests the difference; if the amounts tally exactly no venmo activity is needed and the task is simply completed. complete_task takes no answer; its person/amount/note parameters are record identifiers only.

plan: (venmo-create-transaction valerie-email amount-difference venmo-token note-adjusting-amazon-payment valerie c4)
